SearchFormDefinition.Source: select ta.id,fg.functionalGroupId,fg.name,fg.type,im.itemNumber,im.description,cat.categoryName,im.eol,site.siteDescription,ct.costTypeName,ta.lastChangedOn,ta.lastChangedBy from PcmCostRecord cr inner join cr.costType ct inner join cr.sourcingLane sl inner join sl.item im inner join im.assignments ia inner join im.categories cat inner join im.functionalGroups fg inner join fg.allocations ta inner join ta.site site
SearchFormDefinition.ExtractSource: select ta.id,fg.functionalGroupId,fg.name,fg.type,im.itemNumber,im.description,cat.categoryName,im.eol,site.siteDescription,ct.costTypeName,ta.lastChangedOn,ta.lastChangedBy from PcmCostRecord cr inner join cr.costType ct inner join cr.sourcingLane sl inner join sl.item im inner join im.assignments ia inner join im.categories cat inner join im.functionalGroups fg inner join fg.allocations ta inner join ta.site site

Filters.FilterExpression: im.itemKey NOT IN(select im.itemKey from im.assignments ia where ia.responsibility='PRODUCTION')
